run_inpaint_pipeline: run the OnnxStableDiffusionInpaintPipeline to inpaint masked regions of an image using a text prompt
prepare_mask_and_masked_image: prepare a binary mask and masked image numpy arrays from PIL images for inpainting
encode_prompt: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the text encoder and tokenizer
check_inputs: validate prompt, height, width, and callback_steps inputs before running the inpainting pipeline
initialize_pipeline: initialize an OnnxStableDiffusionInpaintPipeline with ONNX models for VAE, UNet, text encoder, and scheduler
